text:
Type: rustic farmhouse coffee table
Use: holding drinks, books and decor in front of a sofa; living room
Style: farmhouse, coastal, rustic
Materials: reclaimed wood top with parquet pattern, distressed painted wood base
Colors: warm natural wood, distressed white
Shape: large rectangular top with diamond parquet inlay, open trestle base with X-braced sides, square legs, low and substantial
Feel: relaxed, airy, homey
Goes with: linen sofas, white walls, wicker baskets, blue accents; farmhouse or coastal living rooms

product.name: Amazon Brand – Stone & Beam Coastal Breeze Rustic Farmhouse Coffee Table, 55.1"W, Natural and White
product.description: Bring a relaxing coastal feel into your home with the simple beauty of this coffee table. A top of recycled elm is paired with a poplar wood base and given a distressed white painted finish. This piece also blends with modern farmhouse décor. 55.1”W x 31.5”D x 16.1”H Reclaimed elm top on base of poplar wood Rustic wood makes this table work with coastal or modern farmhouse style A beautifully simple table great for magazines or snack trays Assembly required. Wipe with soft dry cloth. Free returns for 30 days. 3-year warranty.
